# Scaffold Raised $15M From the Homebuilders It Sells To. The Channel Is the Investor Again.

A seed round led by Navitas Capital, with D.R. Horton, PulteGroup and Builders FirstSource all on the cap table. Scaffold is not selling homebuilders another application — it is selling them a translation layer between the ones they already run.

 HP Hugo Pegley Editor & Founder 

 

Scaffold has announced a $15 million seed round led by Navitas Capital, dated 15 September from Austin, Texas. The company sells software that sits between homebuilders and their trade contractors, reconciling the data that moves between two sets of systems that were never designed to talk to each other.
